### Why prepare-only (honest constraint)
The two upstream unblockers landed since the original P21.3 run: RIGHTS.1 (P21.1 re-run) flipped `okc_procurement`/`okcpd_policy`/`ok_statute`/`okc_council`/`osm_overpass`/`deflock_repo` to `ingestion_permitted=true` (HG-03), and LIVE.1a (P23.5) added the three OKC document connectors + wired them into `runner.CONNECTOR_FOR_SOURCE`. But HG-09 (`SIG_*` tokens) is `provided: no` and this isolated context has no network — so the actual fetch (HttpxTransport + OCFL capture into PG) still cannot execute. This re-run verifies the wiring is complete/correct now that the sources are green, re-confirms the deterministic ACs, and records the exact commands + gate status. It changes NO product code.

### What this re-run did (verification, not modification)
1. **Gate now passes for the green sources.** `review-status --source <id>` shows all five gate fields `True` + `loadable now: True` for all six OKC critical-path sources. `live_gate_reasons(<id>)` = `[]` (empty) for all six — `run --mode live` NO LONGER refuses them on gate grounds. (Not run past the gate: no tokens/network, avoid any egress.)
2. **Deterministic gate/isolation/shadow ACs still hold** (verbatim results below).
3. **LIVE_WIRING_REPORT.md** got an append-only dated section: OKC sources marked GATE-CLEARED for HG-03, live fetch pending HG-09 + network, with the exact single command per source.
4. **No incremental product code needed.** The example the ticket names — "the LIVE.1a document connectors' registration in the live path" — is already present (`CONNECTOR_FOR_SOURCE` maps `okc_procurement`/`okcpd_policy`/`ok_statute` to their connectors, added by P23.5). The remaining live-path steps (per-source live-target enumeration + parsing of live HTML/PDF bytes rather than the fixture JSON) cannot be verified without network/tokens and are proven today only over the committed fixtures (shadow/replay diff=0); wiring a half-verifiable live parse would fabricate completeness, which the ticket forbids. So: change no product code; carry the live fetch as a gate-pending obligation.
